fix(web-js-sdk): invalidate session when refresh token expires in an open tab (#1538)

## Related Issues
Fixes: https://github.com/descope/etc/issues/19077

## Description
When the session token is about to expire together with the refresh
token, the SDK stopped scheduling refreshes, so nothing told the app the
session was gone and `isAuthenticated` stayed `true` in an open tab
until the user switched tabs or made a request. Now the SDK schedules a
refresh for the moment the session expires. If the refresh token expired
too, the refresh fails with 401, which clears the tokens and notifies
subscribers like any failed refresh

## In a Nutshell
- Refresh at session expiration instead of skipping when the session is
too close to it
- Never sooner than the 20s threshold, so a client clock ahead of the
server cannot cause a refresh loop
